from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os
import numpy as np
import ml_dtypes
from tessera import runtime as rt
from tessera.compiler.emit.nvidia_cuda import NvidiaDeviceSession
from tests.unit.test_sm120_coalesced_activation import activation_package
assert rt._nvidia_device_name()=="sm_120"
rows=[]
for storage,dtype,emask,fmask in (("f16",np.float16,0x7c00,0x3ff),("bf16",ml_dtypes.bfloat16,0x7f80,0x7f)):
 shape=(257,257)
 artifact,package=activation_package(storage,shape,"flat_128")
 bits=np.resize(np.arange(65536,dtype=np.uint16),shape)
 expected=bits.copy()
 nan=((bits & emask)==emask) & ((bits & fmask)!=0)
 negative=((bits & 0x8000)!=0) & ~nan
 if storage=="bf16":negative &= (bits & 0x7fff)!=0
 expected[negative]=0
 with NvidiaDeviceSession() as session, NvidiaDeviceSession() as foreign:
  source=session.upload(bits.view(dtype))
  output=session.upload(np.full(shape,0x5a5a,np.uint16).view(dtype))
  bindings={artifact.input_name:source,artifact.output_name:output}
  rt._submit_nvidia_sm120_native(package.image,package.descriptor,bindings,
      {"Rows":shape[0],"Columns":shape[1]},session.stream)
  actual=session.download(output)
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual.view(np.uint16),expected)
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(session.download(source).view(np.uint16),bits)
  try:
   rt._submit_nvidia_sm120_native(package.image,package.descriptor,bindings,
       {"Rows":shape[0],"Columns":shape[1]},foreign.stream)
  except (ValueError,RuntimeError) as exc:
   assert "stream" in str(exc).lower(),str(exc)
   refusal=str(exc)
  else:raise AssertionError("foreign producer stream unexpectedly accepted")
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(session.download(output).view(np.uint16),expected)
 rows.append({"storage":storage,"shape":list(shape),"unique_patterns":65536,"mismatches":0,"source_unchanged":True,"foreign_stream_refused":refusal,"rejected_launch_preserved_output":True,"image_digest":package.image.image_digest})
 print(json.dumps(rows[-1]),flush=True)
